item.title: Re: 314 overhaul
item.content:encoded:
Just a year late with a response, but SCP-281 can expand 1 millisecond out to 9 minutes which is an expansion of 540,000 times. Using a standard high speed camera would allow you to get a fairly accurate measure of it's speed as well as determining if the obelisk/blade could survive the transition from normal speed to the altered time speed of the alarm clock.

Also, if it actually did move at relativistic speeds it would result in nuclear fusion of the atoms in it's way as it moved at those speeds and smashed them out of the way or against the blade, or nuclear fission as it cut atoms apart that could not move in time.

item.title: Re: 314 overhaul
item.content:encoded:
Sentient, Etymology:

"capable of feeling," from L. sentientem (nom. sentiens) "feeling," prp. of sentire "to feel" (see sense). Meaning "conscious" (of something) is from 1815.

item.title: Re: 314 overhaul
item.content:encoded:
Hmm… I can't find many examples of "sentient" being used as a synonym for "aware" but as far as I can tell it's cromulent. I might change that anyway for sake of clarity, or just leave it at being sentient. Whenever I need to use a term like sentient or sapient I try to do it in a way that underlines the difference between the two. Thus the stress on it being sentient as in aware of its surroundings versus having comparably human intelligence.

I'm open to suggestions on how to explain it moves faster than should be possible, such as at relativistic speeds. That's kind of what I was going for with the "appears to be in two places at once" bit but I'm a lousy physicist.

and displays turning speed and cornering abilities considered impossible given our current understanding of physics

Correct me if I'm wrong, but shouldn't any non-relativistic acceleration be possible given sufficient force? Granted, said force might require colossal amounts of energy to apply in the observed time frame, but this thing already applies force constantly (by hovering against gravity), and uses more of it when it speeds towards things to slice them, all without any readily apparent source. It really shouldn't surprise anyone that it's capable of moving from one direction to another really really fast.

That being said, as is, this has nothing going for it.
